public.title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
public.description: Return the greatest number of cells in a path that moves up, down, left or right and strictly increases at every step. Rectangular dimensions are 0 to 50; integer values are between -10000 and 10000. Empty or zero-width matrices return zero.
hints: Strict increases form a graph with no directed cycles.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Memoize the longest path starting at each cell. Each cell examines four neighbors once. O(rows times columns) time and space.
